verdict.rationale: NetHunt documents a first-party way to connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant, which implies users can operate the CRM through natural-language commands in those assistants. The evidence is a single marketing line that does not say which actions are supported, and NetHunt has no native in-app natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: documentation of which CRM operations can be run via natural language, a native in-product natural-language command interface, setup/tool documentation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, or any MCP-compatible assistant to NetHunt in a few clicks.
